llff.initialization: same FSGS three-training-view MVS PLY per scene for every method
llff.metrics: RGB PSNR, Graphdeco SSIM, VGG LPIPS; mean over held-out views within each scene, then equal-weight mean over 8 scenes

methods.vanilla_3DGS: Graphdeco base; SSIM from common cross-reevaluation
methods.DNGaussian: local LLFF/MVS depth and shape-regularized adaptation
methods.DropoutGS: local LLFF/MVS adaptation with dropout 0.4 and consistency weight 0.4
methods.Difix3D_10k: local 5k base + 5k repair adaptation; test camera poses visible
methods.our_R4: RGB-D teacher and pseudo-view training; test camera poses visible

dtu.metrics: CoR-GS 25-view object-mask foreground PSNR; white-background Graphdeco SSIM and VGG LPIPS; equal-weight mean over 15 scans; sample standard deviation across scans

DNGaussian.initialization: author rand_pcd ~1000 points; bounds from 49-camera COLMAP sparse model
DNGaussian.depth_input: DPT 16-bit maps quantized to 8-bit for local loader

DropoutGS.initialization: author rand_pcd ~1000 points; bounds from 49-camera COLMAP sparse model
DropoutGS.depth_input: DPT 16-bit maps quantized to 8-bit for local loader

our_R4.extra_input: RGB-D teacher and 8 held-out pseudo-target poses; 5 of those are evaluation camera poses, no evaluation RGB
